:::{#def-cross-product-matrix}
#### Cross-product matrix (sum-of-squares and cross-products matrix)

The **cross-product matrix** $\sscp$ of [term vectors](#def-term-vector)
$\termvec{\iobs}$, $\iobs \in \obsidx$, of a training set indexed by $\obsidx$,
is the sum of their outer products:

$$
\sscp \eqdef \sum_{\iobs \in \obsidx} \soprod{\termvec{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-cross-product-matrix}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

Sanchez [-@sanchez2020matrix4sl, chap. "Matrix Cross-Products"] (see [the chapter online](https://www.gastonsanchez.com/matrix4sl/cross-products.html#cross-products)) names this matrix a **sum-of-squares and cross-products matrix**.
:::
